tasks.title: Syntax adapter and outline split
tasks.acceptance_contract: edit a function body and keep its header/bucket fingerprints unchanged; insert lines before an unchanged function and update its displayed location; cold missing-name and unsupported-expression fixtures outline successfully.

tasks.title: Query fetch, dependency validation, and cycles
tasks.acceptance_contract: synthetic diamond dependency graph runs each provider once per invalidating change; unchanged-output recomputation keeps downstream reuse; active cycle returns a typed non-cacheable error; breaking that cycle by an edit succeeds immediately; repeated ordinary function identity lookup is not a cycle.

tasks.title: Fine-grained input publication and negative dependencies
tasks.acceptance_contract: adding a previously absent name invalidates cached missing lookup; body-only edits do not invalidate name buckets; duplicate candidates are deterministic; a failed query with unchanged dependencies is cached. Trace includes provider execute/reuse/invalidated events with real counts.

tasks.title: Cache budgets and source-map attachment
tasks.acceptance_contract: constrained synthetic cache tests evict deterministic victims; a live parse/source-map handle is pinned; an edited line offset cannot produce an old line number. Gate 01 records provider counts for the edit matrix's initial rows.

tasks.title: Namespaces and imports
tasks.acceptance_contract: lexical shadowing, explicit-vs-glob resolution, missing/ambiguous imports, cyclic reexports, and inactive cfg items have dedicated deterministic tests. A macro-blocked namespace cannot be reported complete.

tasks.title: Called-body structural index
tasks.acceptance_contract: an entered function containing a cold invalid branch indexes without resolving that branch; nested function bodies are opaque; node/slot budgets fail only when that body is reached. Repeat indexing yields identical keys.

tasks.title: Minimal LRIR types and verifier
tasks.acceptance_contract: malformed slot kinds and missing terminal exits fail structural verification; a legal Unsupported recipe passes structural verification but faults on execution. No successor thunk is requested by a branch recipe.

tasks.title: Primitive values and checked arenas
tasks.acceptance_contract: stale/wrong-arena/zero/out-of-range handles fail; bit-copy cannot bypass guest ownership; ValueRepr layout assertions pass. A run reset invalidates every previous guest handle.

tasks.title: First VM path
tasks.acceptance_contract: no AST evaluator exists; opcode counters are nonzero and accurate; a following cold function is not semantically queried. The CLI prints a structured actual result, not a hard-coded success.

tasks.title: Numeric operations and contexts
tasks.acceptance_contract: exhaustive i8/u8 arithmetic boundary loops; random wider arithmetic/cast comparisons; works/fails context examples; signed-min literal; distinct usize/u64 contracts. Gate rejects silent i32 defaulting.

tasks.title: Blocks, let, assignment, and shadowing
tasks.acceptance_contract: RHS-before-LHS assignment trace; new binding initializer sees the old shadowed binding; immutable reassignment faults; loop-local reincarnations do not reuse stale refs or leak ownership. Source invalidity after an early return remains untouched.

tasks.title: If, short circuit, while, and loop
tasks.acceptance_contract: cold undefined branch and short-circuit RHS have zero thunk/query events; hot condition loops terminate correctly; nested labeled break/continue choose correct scopes. Fuel exhaustion is deterministic.

tasks.title: Function signatures and call packets
tasks.acceptance_contract: uncalled invalid function signature/body does not fail another call; an unused generic bound is ignored; incompatible actual parameter/return descriptors fault only at reached boundaries; effectful arguments execute once.

tasks.title: Dispatcher-owned recursion and interruption
tasks.acceptance_contract: recursive factorial with concrete types; deep recursion hits guest frame limit rather than host stack overflow; cancellation/fuel produce the specified status and no duplicated output. Host call stack depth stays bounded in a 2,000-frame fixture.

tasks.title: Minimal test harness and builtin assertions
tasks.acceptance_contract: one selected test passes despite another broken body; exact/substr/no-match behavior works; should_panic cannot accept an unsupported-feature fault. Add the fixture manifest/harness format from Section 28.

tasks.title: Nominal/tuple/array descriptors and construction
tasks.acceptance_contract: named-field written evaluation order differs correctly from declaration-order storage; duplicate/missing field faults occur at reached construction; partial constructor panic drops completed fields once; cold unused schema errors are not forced.

tasks.title: Places and leases
tasks.acceptance_contract: out-of-bounds/index-type faults; same-location scalar assignment remains visible through a ref; whole move invalidates inline refs; shared writes fail; two mutable guest aliases serialize without a host RefCell panic.

tasks.title: Copy, move, and partial initialization
tasks.acceptance_contract: String move/use-after-move; Copy scalar repeat reads; partial tuple/struct moves preserve other fields; double-owner property tests fail the buggy model and pass the implementation.

tasks.title: Lexical scopes and temporary annotations
tasks.acceptance_contract: direct extending borrow, tuple/struct extension, extending pattern, non-extending call, Rust 2024 if-let else, block tail, and short-circuit temporary lifetimes match the recorded supported oracle cases.

tasks.title: User Drop and explicit cleanup machine
tasks.acceptance_contract: normal/drop/replace/early-return paths drop once; cold Drop body is prepared only on drop; partial moves skip moved fields; bounded ambiguous Drop selection faults when reached.

tasks.title: Guest panic unwinding and fatal faults
tasks.acceptance_contract: separate fixtures assert each difference through drop output; worker crash is not should_panic success; hostpanic injection terminates only the worker process in integration tests.

tasks.title: Transactional pattern engine
tasks.acceptance_contract: failed arms preserve scrutinee ownership; true arms move once; conflicting moves fault before commit; or-pattern names/modes and binding order validate; overlapping alternatives can rerun false guards without replaying scrutinee evaluation.

tasks.title: Match, if-let, while-let, let-else, and question mark
tasks.acceptance_contract: unvisited arms have no semantic thunks; no-match fault is reached only after all mismatches; let-else normal fallthrough faults; question-mark error type mismatch fails at return boundary without From resolution.

tasks.title: Inherent and restricted trait dispatch
tasks.acceptance_contract: receiver-rank precedence; unused bound succeeds; reached missing method fails; new competing impl invalidates cached dispatch; bounded candidate is not silently discarded.

tasks.title: Named function values
tasks.acceptance_contract: call a selected function through a local variable; incompatible fn signature faults; a numeric payload cannot become a callable; closure creation receives the specific unsupported diagnostic only when reached.

tasks.title: Pure constants
tasks.acceptance_contract: array length constant, recursive bounded const fn, cycle, cold effect branch, reached forbidden effect, and two uses with independently mutable guest arrays. Constant memo contains no guest handles.

tasks.title: Vec and slice operations
tasks.acceptance_contract: push/pop/get/get_mut/index/slice, reallocation invalidation, nonreallocating push preservation, pop invalidating only removed element, consuming iteration drops remaining elements, quota reservation preserves prior ownership.

tasks.title: String and formatting
tasks.acceptance_contract: multibyte len/char/slice cases; invalid boundary panic/error; formatter unsupported spec; capture-name lookup; formatting never moves String; failure-only assert message remains lazy.

tasks.title: Option, Result, scalar methods, and iterators
tasks.acceptance_contract: empty Option/Result explicit context; unwrap/expect panics; `collect::<Vec<i64>>`, enumerate/count, inclusive max integer range terminates without overflow; user iterator fails explicitly.

tasks.title: Macros and derives
tasks.acceptance_contract: vec list/repeat including zero count evaluation; Debug/Copy/Clone/PartialEq/Eq field rules; unknown derive completeness; source-position intrinsics after edit; includes are source dependencies with deferred errors; user macros never execute.

tasks.title: Worker protocol and fake-broker equivalence
tasks.acceptance_contract: malformed/oversized/truncated frames fail closed; duplicate replies do not replay effects; 100 sequential tests retain caches but no guest state.

tasks.title: Real broker permissions
tasks.acceptance_contract: default FS deny, read-only grant, write-only grant, prefix confusion, `..`, absolute path, escaping symlink, oversized read, and reused native policy scenario through the fake artifact stub until JIT arrives. No worker std::fs/env/process operation is introduced.

tasks.title: Freeze ABI and helper registration
tasks.acceptance_contract: wrong ABI status, wrong frame ID, stale semantic epoch, unlisted symbol, and wrong scratch layout fail safely. The three permitted unsafe modules contain documented preconditions at every unsafe block.

tasks.title: Record real executions and form regions
tasks.acceptance_contract: skipped branch/callee never enters a region; errored operation is excluded; effect/call splits occur; repeated traversal count is separate from opcode count; no guest value payload enters an observation.

tasks.title: Generic Cranelift lowering
tasks.acceptance_contract: force-mode repeated loop has actual native entries and helper-op counts; recursive guest calls still use dispatcher frames; a failed helper exits before following helper; interpreter/native transcript and fuel match.

tasks.title: Precise exits and once-only resumption
tasks.acceptance_contract: inject guard misses after zero, one, and multiple completed operations; earlier writes/output/ownership transfers occur once; the missed operation executes once; later operations are not skipped. Artificial ABI inconsistency fails as an internal defect.

tasks.title: Promotion policy and compilation failures
tasks.acceptance_contract: auto threshold32 exact; force observes before compiling; one-shot force fixture reports zero native entries without replay; auto compile-resource fallback is visible; force compile failure fails its fixture.

tasks.title: Scalar staging and commit
tasks.acceptance_contract: unresolved literal, different type, moved slot, or changed descriptor causes Deopt before commit; failure uses interpreter diagnosis; output slot ownership is reserved before mutation; scratch access never escapes.

tasks.title: Whitelisted fast paths
tasks.acceptance_contract: boundary tables and 10,000 random pairs per arithmetic/comparison type match the shared helper; native_scalar_ops is positive in hot-add/compare fixtures; multiplication/float fixtures execute via helpers, not invented unsupported fast paths.

tasks.title: Artifact provenance and edit reuse
tasks.acceptance_contract: every Section 22.5 edit matrix row; permission changes do not recompile but deny effects; source-position intrinsics reflect new lines; changed shape triggers a guard miss without a second artifact for the same region recipe.

tasks.title: Module arena retirement
tasks.acceptance_contract: tiny test budgets repeatedly create/evict arenas, no stale pointer is callable, active invocation prevents free, dropped entry cannot be relabeled as another artifact, and RSS stress does not grow without bound across source revisions.

tasks.title: Native audit and reproducible diagnostics
tasks.acceptance_contract: deliberately malformed native plan is rejected before publication; diagnostic bundle is bounded/redacted; real CLIF dumps correspond to regions that entered native execution.

tasks.title: Managed Cargo manifest subset audit
tasks.acceptance_contract: ordinary two-package workspace accepted; optional/target-specific/build/proc-macro dependencies rejected; missing lock/cache fails offline; sentinel build.rs and proc-macro never execute.

tasks.title: Prepared units and staleness
tasks.acceptance_contract: unit vs integration vs run cfg fixtures; duplicate target ambiguity; manifest/lock/config edit blocks execution until prepare; source body edit does not require prepare. No rlib or generated-output loading path exists.

tasks.title: Complete CLI and test result schema
tasks.acceptance_contract: golden CLI parser cases; ignored/should_panic/no-match semantics; real counters serialized; unsupported sandbox request exits before source execution.

tasks.title: Stdio service and atomic overlays
tasks.acceptance_contract: one client edits called function and reruns with cache reuse; concurrent cancel is processed; malformed request does not mutate snapshot; guest/protocol bytes cannot inject stdout log records.

tasks.title: Watch, shutdown, and worker recovery
tasks.acceptance_contract: repeated rapid source changes run only committed snapshots; no mixed revisions; crash resets native cache claims; shutdown reaps worker and releases broker resources.

tasks.title: Native Rust oracle harness
tasks.acceptance_contract: oracle cache keys include all source/helper/compiler inputs; unsupported-relaxed fixtures are never sent to rustc as expected-pass cases; outputs/drop order/results compare with explicit normalizations.

tasks.title: Three-mode equivalence harness
tasks.acceptance_contract: same value/panic/fault, source origin, output, ownership/drop log, and fuel; mode-specific native counters differ as expected. Every force-native fixture must assert actual entries and direct scalar entries where applicable.

tasks.title: Generators and reducer
tasks.acceptance_contract: injected arithmetic, ownership, stale-cache, and replay bugs are caught; reducer produces a smaller failing fixture preserving expected failure class. Persist seeds and reduced cases as regression tests.

tasks.title: Protocol, parser, and quota stress
tasks.acceptance_contract: no unbounded allocation, hang, host panic on guest input, or unauthorized effect; timeouts are classified and subprocesses reaped.

tasks.title: Full feature/diagnostic coverage audit
tasks.acceptance_contract: deleting a referenced fixture or leaving a release TODO/not-yet-implemented code makes the gate fail. Coverage is about actual exercised paths, not only file presence.

tasks.title: Benchmark driver and datasets
tasks.acceptance_contract: setup time is separated correctly; native run includes compilation when promised; rustc/cargo baseline commands and cache states are recorded; source changes are verified, not simulated counters.

tasks.title: Profile actual overhead
tasks.acceptance_contract: totals/overlaps are documented; pure interpreter vs generic native vs direct-scalar counters explain the observed results; no unsupported speedup claim appears.

tasks.title: Implement only local in-architecture improvements
tasks.acceptance_contract: all gates rerun unchanged; benchmark raw results show the change's effect. A nonimproving patch is reverted, not rationalized.

tasks.title: User and agent documentation
tasks.acceptance_contract: every documented command is exercised in a clean integration test; screenshots or examples do not imply unimplemented capabilities.

tasks.title: Reproduce from clean checkout
tasks.acceptance_contract: all mandatory gates pass without untracked source files; fixture/benchmark artifacts are attached; version/license/vendor manifest complete; no ignored selected fixture, stale fixture expectation, or degraded JIT run remains.
